name: PyMC Playtime Recorder
description: Records your Minecraft playtime (position, look direction, block neighbourhood, nearby entities and the keys you pressed) into a dataset that PyMC Bot trains a player LLM on. Use /pymc record start (or the Record hotkey), play, then /pymc export. One jar per Minecraft version, 1.21.1 to 26.3. Made with ❤️ by codero-sus.
